purpose: Fourteenth expanded public source layer focused on additional enzyme and process-aware strategic disconnections: lipase/esterase resolution and acylation, nitrile-metabolizing enzyme routes, ene-reductase asymmetric alkene reduction, methyltransferase/acyltransferase tailoring enzymes, enzymatic C1 fixation or decarboxylation, oxygenase/peroxygenase epoxidation and hydroxylation, chemoenzymatic dynamic kinetic resolution, and immobilized-enzyme or continuous-flow biocatalysis process boundaries.

promotion_requirements: manual chemist, enzymologist, and process review
explicit substrate, product, enzyme class, selectivity, yield-ceiling or process-boundary metadata before proposal promotion
separate lipase, esterase, nitrilase, nitrile hydratase, amidase, ene-reductase, tailoring-enzyme, carboxylase, decarboxylase, oxygenase, peroxygenase, DKR, immobilization, and flow-process policy
route-specific enzyme scope, substrate recognition, stereochemical or regioselective outcome, donor/cofactor handling, support/catalyst lifetime, cascade order, and process provenance review
toxicology, environmental, bioactive-natural-product, whole-cell, immobilized-catalyst, solvent, oxygenation, or process-safety review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, procedures, expression protocols, and operating conditions
process and enzyme records are source-backed strategic priors only and must not auto-close routes as stock, wet-lab recipes, or validated manufacturing processes

families.name: Lipase and esterase kinetic resolution, desymmetrization, and acylation route anchors
families.strategic_principle: Separate substrate or prochiral diester synthesis, enzyme selectivity, acyl donor or hydrolysis role, and yield-ceiling policy. Lipase/esterase routes are strategic resolution or desymmetrization records, not ordinary esterification templates.

families.name: Nitrilase, nitrile-hydratase, and amidase routes to acids, amides, and chiral carboxylates
families.strategic_principle: Separate nitrile precursor design from enzymatic hydration, hydrolysis, or amide resolution. Chemoselectivity, enantioselectivity, and nitrile-to-acid/amide process precedent define route value.

families.name: Ene-reductase and old yellow enzyme asymmetric activated-alkene reduction
families.strategic_principle: Separate activated alkene precursor access, C=C geometry, enzyme facial selectivity, and cofactor recycling. Ene-reductase logic is route-defining when alkene reduction creates stereochemistry or avoids chemoselectivity problems.

families.name: Methyltransferase, acyltransferase, and natural-product tailoring-enzyme route anchors
families.strategic_principle: Separate scaffold assembly from donor-dependent tailoring, regioselectivity, and biosynthetic context. Tailoring-enzyme identity can define an analogue strategy even when the formal bond is a methyl, acyl, or heteroatom substituent.

families.name: Carboxylase, decarboxylase, and enzymatic C1 fixation or removal route handles
families.strategic_principle: Separate C1 source or carboxyl group logic from ordinary carboxylation/decarboxylation templates. CO2/bicarbonate insertion, carboxylate loss, and thermodynamic driving force are route metadata.

families.name: Peroxygenase, monooxygenase, epoxidase, and dioxygenase oxygenation strategy
families.strategic_principle: Separate alkene or arene precursor synthesis from enzyme-controlled epoxidation, hydroxylation, dihydroxylation, or oxygenation pattern. Oxygen transfer mode, site selectivity, and oxidative risk are strategic fields.

families.name: Chemoenzymatic dynamic kinetic resolution, deracemization, and cascade-resolution boundaries
families.strategic_principle: Separate chemical racemization, enzyme selectivity, resolution yield ceiling, and cascade compatibility. A DKR or deracemization route must represent both the chemical and enzymatic halves.

families.name: Immobilized-enzyme, packed-bed, and continuous-flow biocatalysis process boundaries
families.strategic_principle: Separate molecular retrosynthesis from process-intensification evidence. Catalyst support, lifetime, mass transfer, packed-bed or wall-immobilized format, and downstream integration can be route-defining.

anchors.name: Lipase/esterase anchor with reviewed substrate class, selectivity mode, acyl donor or hydrolysis role, and resolution ceiling
Nitrile-metabolizing enzyme anchor with reviewed nitrile precursor, enzyme class, acid/amide endpoint, and selectivity
Ene-reductase anchor with reviewed activated alkene, E/Z geometry, facial selectivity, and cofactor handling
Tailoring-enzyme anchor with reviewed scaffold, donor identity, enzyme family, and regioselective modification
Carboxylase/decarboxylase C1 route anchor with reviewed CO2 source or carboxyl-loss logic and thermodynamic policy
Enzymatic oxygenation anchor with reviewed substrate, oxygenation pattern, enzyme class, and oxidative-safety policy
Chemoenzymatic DKR anchor with reviewed racemization, enzyme selectivity, cascade compatibility, and mass balance
Immobilized or flow biocatalysis anchor with reviewed support, reactor boundary, catalyst lifetime, and process integration

disconnections.name: Enantioenriched alcohol or ester to racemate plus lipase/esterase acylation or hydrolysis policy

forward_logic: separate racemate preparation from enzymatic resolution
track acyl donor or hydrolysis role and maximum yield ceiling
carry enzyme selectivity and unresolved enantiomer fate into route ranking
suggested_precursor_roles: acyl donor or hydrolysis condition class
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward lipase/esterase resolution only when the route exposes selectivity, yield ceiling, and fate of the undesired enantiomer.

evidence.citation: Lipase review covers kinetic resolution access to enantiomerically pure or enriched compounds.
Lipase-mediated pharmaceutical-intermediate review supports lipase routes for preparation and resolution of useful intermediates.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit racemate, enzyme selectivity, acyl/hydrolysis role, and yield-ceiling policy

disconnections.name: Desymmetrized or dynamically resolved product to meso/racemizing precursor plus lipase/esterase policy

forward_logic: separate meso or racemizing precursor synthesis from enzyme-selective transformation
track whether the route is desymmetrization, KR, or DKR
require explicit racemization or symmetry-breaking evidence before promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use this record when enzyme selectivity breaks symmetry or pairs with racemization, not for a generic ester interchange.

evidence.citation: Lipase dynamic-kinetic-resolution review supports lipases as route handles for DKR.
Chemoenzymatic DKR review covers dynamic resolution strategies for enantiopure alcohols and amines.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit meso/racemizing precursor, selectivity, racemization, and mass balance

disconnections.name: Chiral acid or amide to nitrile precursor plus nitrilase/amidase selectivity policy

forward_logic: disconnect acid or amide products to nitrile or amide precursors
track enzyme class as nitrilase, nitrile hydratase, or amidase
carry enantioselectivity and endpoint identity into route ranking
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward nitrile-enzyme routes when nitrile precursor access and enzyme endpoint selectivity are explicit.

risks: nitrile toxicity and handling review required

evidence.citation: Nitrile-metabolizing enzyme review covers nitrilases, nitrile hydratases, and amidases in biocatalysis.
Microbial nitrile-transformation review supports nitrile conversion to high-value acids or amides.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit nitrile precursor, enzyme class, endpoint, and selectivity

disconnections.name: Amide or acid product to nitrile-hydratase/amidase sequence plus process-boundary policy

forward_logic: separate nitrile access from hydration and hydrolysis enzyme sequence
track whether the target endpoint is amide isolation or acid formation
flag process routes for substrate loading, toxicity, and downstream review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use nitrile-hydratase/amidase records when endpoint control and process precedent matter more than formal hydrolysis.

evidence.citation: Nitrile-degrading enzyme review provides public context for nitrilase, hydratase, and amidase route roles.
Nitrile biotransformation review covers microbial conversion of nitriles to acids or amides.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit enzyme sequence, endpoint identity, and process boundary

disconnections.name: Saturated stereocenter product to activated alkene plus ene-reductase facial-selectivity policy

break_bonds: activated alkene to saturated stereocenter boundary
forward_logic: disconnect saturated product to the corresponding activated alkene
track E/Z geometry, electron-withdrawing group, and enzyme facial selectivity
carry cofactor and product stereochemistry into route ranking
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward ene-reductase routes when alkene geometry and enzyme facial selectivity are explicitly represented.

evidence.citation: Ene-reductase review describes ene-reductases as multifaceted biocatalysts in organic synthesis.
Industrial ene-reductase review covers discovery, engineering, and applications for biocatalysis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit activated alkene, geometry, enzyme family, cofactor, and stereochemical outcome

disconnections.name: Cascade-derived reduced product to enoate/enone plus old-yellow-enzyme and partner-step policy

forward_logic: separate activated-alkene formation from ene-reductase reduction and downstream/upstream partner steps
track cofactor compatibility across the cascade
flag routes where alkene reduction changes both stereochemistry and process order
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use cascade ene-reductase records when alkene reduction must be coordinated with adjacent enzymatic or chemical steps.

evidence.citation: Review of asymmetric bioreduction of activated alkenes supports ene-reductase use for industrially relevant optically active compounds.
Ene-reductase industrial review covers applications and engineering considerations for process biocatalysis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit activated-alkene precursor, cascade order, cofactor compatibility, and stereochemical role

disconnections.name: Methylated natural-product analogue to parent scaffold plus SAM-dependent methyltransferase policy

target_classes: O-, N-, C-, or S-methylated analogues

forward_logic: separate parent scaffold assembly from donor-dependent methyltransferase tailoring
track donor identity, enzyme class, methylation atom, and biosynthetic context
avoid generic methylation templates when enzyme selectivity defines feasibility
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward methyltransferase records when methylation position and donor/enzyme identity are route-defining.

evidence.citation: SAM-dependent methyltransferase review discusses applications for natural-product biosynthesis and diversification.
Tailoring-enzyme review frames tailoring enzymes as tools for biocombinatorial lead development.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit parent scaffold, methylation atom, donor, enzyme class, and biosynthetic context

disconnections.name: Acylated or decorated natural product to parent scaffold plus acyltransferase/tailoring-module policy

forward_logic: separate scaffold assembly from acyl donor or tailoring-enzyme modification
track donor identity, enzyme family, carrier-domain context, and biological role

retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use acyltransferase tailoring records when donor identity and biosynthetic module context define analogue feasibility.

evidence.citation: NRPS tailoring-enzyme review covers modifications during and after chain elongation on assembly lines.
Tailoring-enzyme review supports genome-based and biocombinatorial use of natural-product tailoring enzymes.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit scaffold, acyl donor, enzyme or module, and biosynthetic context

disconnections.name: Carboxylated product to substrate plus enzymatic CO2 fixation and thermodynamic policy

forward_logic: disconnect carboxylated product to decarboxylated substrate and C1 source
track carboxylase identity, cofactor, and thermodynamic coupling
flag sustainability claims for process and carbon-accounting review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward enzymatic carboxylation only when C1 source, enzyme class, and driving force are explicit.

evidence.citation: Synthetic enzyme-catalyzed CO2 fixation review supports enzymatic carboxylation as a route concept.
Enzymatic CO2 conversion review discusses natural to artificial utilization of CO2.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit C1 source, enzyme, cofactor/energy coupling, and thermodynamic policy

disconnections.name: Decarboxylated product to carboxylate precursor plus decarboxylase and equilibrium policy

forward_logic: separate carboxylate precursor access from enzymatic decarboxylation
track reversibility, pH/process context, and product volatility or capture

retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use decarboxylase entries when carboxylate loss or reversible carboxylation changes precursor strategy.

evidence.citation: Enzymatic CO2 conversion review covers natural and artificial C1 utilization, including carboxylation/decarboxylation logic.
Biocatalytic C-C bond formation review discusses one-carbon resource utilization in enzyme routes.

evidence.citation: Styrene oxygenation cascade review supports side-chain oxygenation as a biotechnological route basis.
Oxygenating-biocatalyst review discusses hydroxyl functionalization in drug discovery and development.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit precursor, oxygenating enzyme, oxygenation site, and oxidant/cofactor policy

disconnections.name: Dihydroxylated or cis-diol product to arene/alkene plus dioxygenase oxygenation policy

evidence.citation: Oxygenating-biocatalyst review gives public context for enzyme-controlled hydroxyl functionalization.
Recent drug-synthesis biocatalysis review includes oxygenation and late functionalization as API-relevant biocatalysis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit arene/alkene precursor, oxygenation pattern, enzyme class, and stereochemical outcome

disconnections.name: Enantiopure product to racemate plus chemical racemization and enzyme-selective resolution policy

evidence.citation: Chemoenzymatic DKR review covers preparation of enantiopure alcohols and amines.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit racemate, racemization catalyst, enzyme selectivity, and mass balance

retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use deracemization records when route feasibility depends on coupled catalysts rather than a single isolated enzymatic step.

evidence.citation: Chemoenzymatic DKR review provides public precedent for coupled chemical and enzymatic stereochemical resolution.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit cascade components, stereochemical bookkeeping, and redox/catalyst compatibility

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit support, reactor, catalyst lifetime, and process integration metadata

disconnections.name: API or natural-product intermediate route to flow-biocatalysis process-intensification policy

track whether immobilization, in-line separation, or reactor integration changes feasibility
flag flow routes for scale, stability, and process-analytical review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use flow-biocatalysis entries when continuous processing changes route viability, not as a generic condition label.

evidence.citation: Flow biocatalysis review frames flow as an alternative for API and natural-compound synthesis.
Enzyme-immobilization flow review discusses unlocking flow biocatalysis through immobilization.

source_notes.summary: The v15 expansion promotes the next enzyme/process backlog batch into source records for lipase/esterase resolution, nitrile-metabolizing enzymes, ene-reductases, tailoring enzymes, enzymatic C1 fixation/removal, oxygenation enzymes, chemoenzymatic DKR/deracemization, and immobilized or flow biocatalysis process boundaries.

V15 records are advisory and evidence-gated. Promotion to proposal generation requires explicit substrate scope, selectivity, endpoint, cofactor/donor handling, process boundary, support/lifetime data where relevant, and safety/process review.
